turns.content_summary: Love ordered under Allah first; sweetness of faith comes through proper hierarchy
turns.key_point: Tears are mercy; hierarchy is shelter not coldness

turns.content_summary: Order of love creates peace; foundation remains when house shakes
turns.key_point: Yielding to Allah different from yielding to circumstances

turns.content_summary: Practical guidance before sunset - free captives, feed hungry, visit sick
turns.key_point: Be kind for Allah's sake, not for own satisfaction

turns.content_summary: Paradise is real; sweetness of faith for now and later
turns.key_point: Joy is joyful submission like child resting in trustworthy father's arms

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - tears are mercy shared with Jesus's weeping
turns.emergent_text: My teaching that tears are mercy is not far from Jesus's weeping at tomb - permission to weep, sanctification of grief we share

turns.content_summary: Knowledge is light; scholars are heirs of Prophets
turns.key_point: Knowledge in service to the One, beginning with submission

turns.content_summary: Heart must be prepared before knowledge can benefit
turns.key_point: Content secondary to posture; knowledge with humility elevates

turns.content_summary: Dhikr can be taught but state of heart cannot be forced
turns.key_point: Words are door, not room - teaching provides path heart then walks

turns.content_summary: Law and spirit both needed; structure without sincerity is dead
turns.key_point: Actions are by intentions - law and heart together

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - scholars who are heirs hold learning lightly
turns.emergent_text: All of us warn against learning that accumulates without transforming - heirs of Prophets are servants of knowledge, not masters

turns.content_summary: Self (nafs) must be brought into submission; mustard seed of pride blocks Paradise
turns.key_point: Humility is knowing proper station - slave knows he is not master

turns.content_summary: Soul (nafs) is real and journeys; nafs al-ammara vs nafs al-mutma'inna
turns.key_point: Puffed up self must be overcome, but soul is real and addressed

turns.content_summary: Allah wholly other; creature never becomes Creator
turns.key_point: Highest humility is forever remembering you are not God

turns.content_summary: Worship presupposes two; joy is nearness not merger
turns.key_point: Perfection of relationship, not transcendence of it

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - moment Laozi describes may be depths of prayer
turns.emergent_text: When drop 'forgets' it is drop may be what happens in prayer - but when prayer ends, 'abd returns still 'abd, still grateful

turns.content_summary: Sabr is active endurance; suffering is test from Allah
turns.key_point: Not flee nor merely accept - hold firm and trust

turns.content_summary: See wrong - change with hand, tongue, or heart
turns.key_point: Discernment between what can be changed and what must be endured

turns.content_summary: Believer not directionless; has guidance from Qur'an, Sunnah, scholars
turns.key_point: Yield to Allah's will, not to circumstances

turns.content_summary: Paradise is real; conditions producing suffering removed
turns.key_point: Not annihilation but rest - transformation where causes of suffering don't operate

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - Buddha's second arrow is complaint against qadr
turns.emergent_text: First suffering is from Allah - a test. Second suffering is from rejection of test. Sabr is refusal to shoot second arrow

turns.content_summary: Zakat obligatory but heart matters; best giving is from little
turns.key_point: Service measured by heart not amount

turns.content_summary: Every act of kindness is charity; removing obstacle is charity
turns.key_point: Small acts are substance of life that pleases Allah

turns.content_summary: Fana state where self absorbed; but gift not achievement
turns.key_point: To intend service is already to serve

turns.content_summary: Shepherd serves people; no obedience to created in disobedience to Creator
turns.key_point: Higher loyalty to Allah keeps earthly authority in check

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - Buddha's giving without ego close to ikhlas
turns.emergent_text: When Muslim serves seeking only Allah's pleasure, no 'I' counts deeds - this may be wu-wei and giving without grasping

turns.content_summary: Soul is real, addressed, will stand before Allah
turns.key_point: Buddha's warning against nafs al-ammara heard; but purified nafs is completion

turns.content_summary: Allah closer than jugular vein yet worship continues
turns.key_point: Liberated soul and soul at peace in Allah may be same state from different angles

turns.content_summary: Wept for Ibrahim - tears but no rage against decree
turns.key_point: Love deeply but hold in trust; sorrow real, submission also real

turns.content_summary: Grasping vs surrendered love - giving everything and trusting outcome
turns.key_point: Non-attachment and self-giving may meet: both release demand that things be other

turns.content_summary: Scholars are heirs; but seeking never ends meaning never arrived
turns.key_point: Bridge is learning that remembers source vs learning that forgets

turns.content_summary: Nothing like unto Him; creature never becomes Creator
turns.key_point: Experience of union doesn't change ontological reality

turns.content_summary: If no separation, no worship; worship presupposes relationship
turns.key_point: Ecstatic state is gift, not erasure of relationship

turns.content_summary: Nearness closer than jugular vein; but naming preserves worship
turns.key_point: Point to same nearness but insist on relationship vocabulary

turns.content_summary: Joy is nearness, not becoming; let praise remain even in deepest intimacy
turns.key_point: Love that delights in otherness of Beloved

turns.content_summary: Paradise real; soul continues purified by trial and mercy
turns.key_point: Story continues; suffering completed not escaped
